name: dotnet-toolchain
label: .NET toolchain
description: The dotnet CLI as a build check, a test check and a command. Run the build check for compiler diagnostics and the test check for failing tests — the two read different output and neither substitutes for the other.

tools.label: dotnet build
tools.description: Builds the solution or project in the working directory and reports MSBuild's canonical file(line,col): error CODE: message diagnostics.

tools.label: dotnet test
tools.description: Runs the test projects and reports each failure at the source line its stack trace names. The test runner emits no diagnostics format cImp parses, so a build that fails under this tool shows up as a non-zero exit with no rows — run the build check for those.

tools.label: dotnet
tools.description: The dotnet CLI itself, for a one-off subcommand (dotnet --info, dotnet list package) through run_command.
